name: handle-flow-file-parent-variable
description: handle's matching branch runs a file-referenced do block that interpolates a variable from the parent script's env, proving the flow file sees the parent's variables
yaml:
appId: com.test
name: handle parent variable
env:
  email: user@test.com
---
- launchApp
- handle:
    - when:
        visible: Login
      do: "{{DIR}}/handle-do.yml"
